headline: Veterans Commission has 2 vacancies and 2 alternate vacancies; officials plan to avoid falling behind on appointments.
summary: Chair Foley reported on Veterans Commission vacancies and met with the mayor's office and Town Clerk about appointments that were on hold. The IT Manager and Technology Commission Chair will give a quarterly update to Legislative Council on October 19. No members of the public spoke.
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
IT & CIVIC ENGAGEMENT 
COMMITTEE MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
 
 
Committee Chair: 
Present - Doug Foley 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Present - Grace Teodosio 
Committee Members: 
Present - Tom Figlar 
Present - Tameeka Parks 
Present - Maurine Crouch 
Ex-Officio Voting: 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, 
Majority Leader 
Present - Bob Anthony, 
Minority Leader  
Ex-Officio Non-Voting 
Absent - Katie Kiely, President   
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
IT & Civic Engagement Committee, September 28, 2026 – 7:00pm.  Chair Foley opened 
the meeting at 8:08pm with the members noted above in attendance.  
  
  
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
No members of the public came forward to speak.  Public Input was closed at 8:10pm.  
  
  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Chair Foley mentioned that the IT Manager and Technology Commission Chair would be 
coming to the Legislative Council meeting on October 19th to provide a quarterly update. 
 
Chair Foley provided an update on the recent Veterans Commission update noting that 
there were currently 2 vacancies and 2 alternate vacancies on the commission.  He noted 
that he met with the mayor’s office and Town Clerk to review the current appointment 
process and ensure everyone understood the process and could bring forward 
appointments that were on hold.  He said that the administration, Council and Town Clerk 
planned to work together to ensure we do not fall behind on appointments in the future. 
Council member Figler thanked Mr. Foley for his efforts to get the process moving.   
 
Mr. Foley also announced that anyone that might be interested in joining a board or 
commission should reach out. 
    
4. COMMITTEE REGULAR AGENDA 
None for this evening  
5. COMMITTEE NEW BUSINESS 
None for this evening  
6. COMMITTEE UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
None for this evening  
7. ADJOURN 
Chair Foley adjourned the meeting at 8:15pm.
